Now let me write a comprehensive test script generating scenarios and comparing with a reference implementation... but I don't have a reference. Let me instead manually test tricky scenarios by inspecting output.

Let me build a helper to run bridge on a scenario dict.

Test cases:
1. IPv4-mapped authority: route "https://[::ffff:192.0.2.1]": expect canonical "::ffff:192.0.2.1". Input authority "[::ffff:c000:201]".
2. IPv4 leading zero reject.
3. content-length huge.
4. Path with %zz invalid, path //, path with space.
5. host repetition, authority+host mismatch.
6. te repeated.
7. cookie joining position.
8. x-list repeated allowed.
9. other repeated reject.
10. trailers non x-audit reject.
11. DATA before HEADERS.
12. third headers.
13. data after trailing headers.
14. unknown frames ignored.

Let me write a test harness printing statuses and origins.

cd /app && cat > /tmp/t.py <<'PY'
import json, subprocess, sys
def run(scn):
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'/app/submission/bridge.py'],input=json.dumps(scn).encode(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    if p.returncode: return {'ERR':p.stderr.decode()}
    return json.loads(p.stdout)

def H(sid, fields): return {'sid':sid,'type':'headers','fields':fields}
def D(sid,hexs): return {'sid':sid,'type':'data','hex':hexs}
def F(sid): return {'sid':sid,'type':'fin'}
def R(sid): return {'sid':sid,'type':'reset'}
def U(sid,ft=33,hexs='00'): return {'sid':sid,'type':'unknown','frame_type':ft,'hex':hexs}

base=lambda m,s,a,path: [[":method",m],[":scheme",s],[":authority",a],[":path",path]]

def show(name,scn):
    r=run(scn)
    if 'ERR' in r: print(name,'ERR',r['ERR']); return
    for st in r['streams']:
        print(name, st['sid'], st['status'], st.get('cache_key'), 'len',st['length'])
    # print origins lengths and content for forwarded
    for k,v in r['origins'].items():
        if v: print('  ',name,'origin',k,v)

# 1 ipv4-mapped
show('v4map',{'routes':{'https://[::ffff:192.0.2.1]':'o'},'events':[H(0,base('GET','https','[::ffff:c000:201]','/')),F(0)]})
# 2 ipv4 leading zero
show('v4lz',{'routes':{'https://1.2.3.4':'o'},'events':[H(0,base('GET','https','01.2.3.4','/')),F(0)]})
# 3 content length huge
show('clhuge',{'routes':{'https://a.test':'o'},'events':[H(0,[[':method','GET'],[':scheme','https'],[':authority','a.test'],[':path','/'],['content-length','999999999999999999999999']]),F(0)]})
# 4 path %zz
show('pctzz',{'routes':{'https://a.test':'o'},'events':[H(0,base('GET','https','a.test','/%zz')),F(0)]})
# 4b path space
show('space',{'routes':{'https://a.test':'o'},'events':[H(0,base('GET','https','a.test','/a b')),F(0)]})
# 5 host repeated
show('hostrep',{'routes':{'https://a.test':'o'},'events':[H(0,[[':method','GET'],[':scheme','https'],[':path','/'],['host','a.test'],['host','a.test']]),F(0)]})
# 5b authority+host mismatch
show('authmismatch',{'routes':{'https://a.test':'o'},'events':[H(0,[[':method','GET'],[':scheme','https'],[':authority','a.test'],[':path','/'],['host','b.test']]),F(0)]})
# 6 te repeated
show('terep',{'routes':{'https://a.test':'o'},'events':[H(0,base('GET','https','a.test','/')+[['te','trailers'],['te','trailers']]),F(0)]})
# 7 cookie position
show('cookie',{'routes':{'https://a.test':'o'},'events':[H(0,base('POST','https','a.test','/')+[['x-first','1'],['cookie','a=1'],['x-mid','2'],['cookie','b=2']]),D(0,''),F(0)]})
# 9 other repeated reject
show('otherrep',{'routes':{'https://a.test':'o'},'events':[H(0,base('GET','https','a.test','/')+[['x-note','1'],['x-note','2']]),F(0)]})
# 9b x-list repeated ok
show('xlist',{'routes':{'https://a.test':'o'},'events':[H(0,base('GET','https','a.test','/')+[['x-list-a','1'],['x-list-a','2'],['x-list-','bad']]),F(0)]})
# 10 trailer non audit
show('trailbad',{'routes':{'https://a.test':'o'},'events':[H(0,base('GET','https','a.test','/')),H(0,[['x-other','v']]),F(0)]})
# 11 data before headers
show('dbefore',{'routes':{'https://a.test':'o'},'events':[D(0,'41'),H(0,base('GET','https','a.test','/')),F(0)]})
# 12 third headers
show('third',{'routes':{'https://a.test':'o'},'events':[H(0,base('GET','https','a.test','/')),H(0,[['x-audit-a','1']]),H(0,[['x-audit-b','2']]),F(0)]})
# 13 data after trailing
show('daftertrail',{'routes':{'https://a.test':'o'},'events':[H(0,base('GET','https','a.test','/')),H(0,[['x-audit-a','1']]),D(0,'41'),F(0)]})
# 14 unknown ignored
show('unk',{'routes':{'https://a.test':'o'},'events':[U(0),H(0,base('GET','https','a.test','/')),U(0,64,'aabb'),F(0)]})
# 15 empty content no trailers
show('emptyCL',{'routes':{'https://a.test':'o'},'events':[H(0,base('GET','https','a.test','/')),F(0)]})
